title: Demonstrators gather outside Israeli embassy in Stockholm to protest attacks

tea.why: Protesters gathered to condemn Israeli military attacks on Palestine and Lebanon.
tea.want: Demanded an immediate halt to attacks on Gaza and an end to Swedish arms sales to Israel.
tea.changed: Nov 7: Hundreds gathered in Stockholm following calls from civil society organizations.

summary: Hundreds of people gathered in Stockholm to protest Israeli military attacks on the Gaza Strip, the occupied West Bank, and Lebanon, as well as ceasefire violations. Responding to calls from several civil society organizations, demonstrators assembled at Odenplan Square before protesting outside the Israeli embassy. Participants carried banners highlighting civilian casualties, the bombing of schools and hospitals, and food shortages. The crowd demanded an immediate halt to military operations and called on the Swedish government to stop selling weapons to Israel. Activists speaking at the event criticized European governments for their stance and voiced support for Palestinian resistance.
demands: Stop Swedish weapons sales to Israel
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: Hundreds of people gathered in Stockholm

updates.text: Hundreds of demonstrators gathered at Odenplan Square and outside the Israeli embassy to protest military actions.
